items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: we can all look at a Picasso or a Renoir or a Michelangelo and say, “Well this is blue, this is green, this is this form, this is that form.

ctx.x: You must like ocarinas, that’s the second time that’s come up.

I know well you know it’s a funny instrument, it’s a funny word, it’s got the hard k sound you know, comedy. What can I tell you? But yeah I like to think that the technology and the music are — it should be a collaboration and a cooperation of how you’re getting this done, which is the same way I’ve always felt that the phrase when they talk about so-and- so you know Intergalactic Records recording artist and so forth, yes, because there is an art to making a recording. And there are some people who are great…
flashy or distracting. Those to me are the — and how do you really define it? It’s like well it’s a mystery. But I mean it’s the sort of thing when things work you just know it.
